base: Being very good at avoiding an old wound can quietly become a reason to keep choosing the life built around avoiding it.
business: Both positions are visible; deal with the tradeoff directly instead of pretending one side can disappear.
shadow: The conflict hardens when each side treats the other as the obstacle instead of part of the decision.

readerCopy.body: Being very good at avoiding an old wound can quietly become a reason to keep choosing the life built around avoiding it. When Chiron opposes the North Node, the safer familiar choice may be the role, routine, or strategy designed to keep you from being embarrassed, rejected, overwhelmed, or hurt again. That protection may have been necessary. Check if it is still protecting you from the same danger or if it is now keeping you away from opportunities that would require a different response.
